method: Pearson correlation of daily simple returns on the ladder's own series (basket rows are the equal-weight basket index), pairwise on the sessions both have, null under 80% of the window. vol is annualised (x sqrt 252); annualised covariance = corr x vol_i x vol_j. beta = corr x vol_i / vol_bench; r2 = corr squared. roll = the 63-session correlation every 5 sessions; field avg = mean pairwise correlation of the non-twin sleeves; pc1 = share of variance on the first principal component of their correlation matrix. Display only.
